Dorothy Canfield Fisher, Understood Betsy.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/dorothy-canfield-fisher/understood-betsy

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Dorothy Canfield Fisher, the author, died 1958 (Wikidata Q5298346, P570 = 1958-11-09).

First publication of the text used: 1916 (SE colophon: 'Understood Betsy was published in 1916 by Dorothy Canfield Fisher.'). The Wikipedia article on the novel gives the country as the USA and the publisher as The Century Co., 1916.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1916, before 1931, so the US rule settles the country of origin too. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it on 1 January 2012.
- Country of origin (United States, first publication 1916): see the paragraph above. The author's death year (1958) does not change this, because the US rule settles the origin whatever the death year.
